chunks: Ghayba of al-Tusi: A group, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Qulawayh and Abi Ghalib al-Zurari and others, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Kulayni, from Ishaq ibn Ya'qub who said:

I asked Muhammad ibn Uthman al-Amri (may Allah have mercy on him) to relay to me a letter in which I had asked about matters that had troubled me, and the Tawqiq came in the handwriting of our Master, the Master of the Age (peace be upon him):

As for what you asked about – may Allah guide you and make you firm – regarding those who reject me from among our family members and the sons of our uncle, then know that there is no kinship between Allah Mighty and Majestic and anyone else. Whoever rejects me then he is not from me and his way is the way of the son of Noah. And as for the way of my paternal uncle Ja'far and his sons, it is the way of the brothers of Joseph (peace be upon him),

As for beer (al-fuq'), then drinking it is forbidden and there is no harm in rye-drink (al-shalab). And as for your wealth, we do not accept it except that you become purified, so whoever wishes let him send it and whoever wishes let him withhold it, for what Allah has given us is better than what He has given you,

As for the appearance of the Relief (al-Faraj), then it is up to Allah and the predictors have lied. And as for the statement of the one who claims that al-Husayn (peace be upon him) was not killed, then it is disbelief, falsehood and misguidance,
As for the events which arise, then return in them to the narrators of our Hadith, for they are my proof over you and I am the proof of Allah over you …
As for Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahziyar al-Ahwazi, then Allah will rectify his heart and remove his doubt from him …

key_terms.ابْنُ نُوْحٍ: The son of Noah (symbol of those who reject the prophet)
key_terms.ظُهُورُ الْفَرَج: The appearance of the Relief (end of occultation)

ai.seo_question: What are the key theological and legal rulings in the Tawqi of al-Tusi regarding the Imam's family and wealth?
ai.summary: This seminal Tawqi from Imam al-Mahdi (aj) serves as a cornerstone of Shia Usuli methodology, establishing the narrators of Hadith as the primary reference for resolving new jurisprudential issues (al-hawadith al-waqi'a). It provides a nuanced theological hierarchy, contrasting the fate of those who deny the Imam with that of his close relatives, while simultaneously clarifying specific fiqh rulings on beverages and the purity of wealth. The decree also affirms core doctrines such as the certainty of the Final Relief and the martyrdom of Imam al-Husayn (as), effectively countering contemporary sectarian doubts.
